title: Full in-time repayment of 1000 clears outstanding to 0 (C52)

source.test: As a user I would like to fully repay the loan in time

scenario: Disburse a 1000 loan, then repay 1000 AUTOPAY on the due date; the loan must reach 0 outstanding.
grade: Assert disbursement sets outstanding 100000 minor; repayment creates a 100000-minor AUTOPAY transaction and outstanding becomes 0.
